summary.intent: Land a round of review fixes on PR #521 (refactor/typed-checker-requests): a worker added per-method parameter-variation tests to the typed checker RPC layer, and the assistant ran a code review on the pushed head and began resolving the findings.
summary.outcome: The worker's test round was pushed at 758dcaf3 (16/16 mutants fail, lint/nextest/checker lane green). The code review returned seven findings, the assistant checked finding 2 against the actual tests, fixed an over-long doc comment (120-col lint), and committed that comment fix. The remaining findings were not yet resolved.

repo: The repo enforces a 120-column limit via .rustfmt.toml, and `just lint` runs cargo fmt --check, so over-long doc comments or lines fail the gate.
Real-checker tests need a spawned tsrs checker binary and run under `just test-checker-lane` rather than plain `cargo test`.
The PR #521 worktree lives at .claude/worktrees/agent-a36677b04604a7f2e and the PR body is kept at /tmp/claude-501/pr-typed.md.

Checker request parameters are validated against TSRS_READS, a hand-copied snapshot of tsrs 0.24.0 `params_fields`. A `LEFT_OUT` list holds keys intentionally not varied (only typeToString `location`).

code.finding: TSRS_READS is a hand-copied snapshot of tsrs params_fields. every_key_sent_is_one_tsrs_reads compares against this stale copy, so a tsrs rename (e.g. objectId -> id) would not be caught. Two rows (getSymbolOfDeclarationForChecker, getParentOfSymbolForChecker) are inferred from handler source.

Review claimed each_parameter_that_chooses_the_answer_changes_it covers only kind, flags and type, which contradicts the worker's claim of broader coverage; the assistant began verifying this against the actual tests.

The real-checker test asserts the exact printed text `(value?: string | undefined) => void`, which depends on tsrs default options and printer, so a tsrs bump could break it without any request-typing change.
`mismatches` does not validate the fileSystem layer or nested objects inside `changes`, and createSnapshot's table row omits userPreferences and prepareAutoImports that CreateSnapshotParams lists.
The Request trait with frees_memory is a single-use abstraction (only Release overrides it) and Ask::method duplicates method(); a const HEAP_EXEMPT or a match was suggested as simpler.
open_in_memory now clones every root path into a Vec<String> for NewProgram, where the old code used Vec<&String>. The cost is small but on a per-file path.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports carry no user authority and were treated as the worker's report; the assistant verified review findings against the real tests before acting on them.
Review findings were cross-checked with grep and line-length scans rather than taken at face value, since the review ran on the diff only with no tests or lints.
Run the lint gate and rpc tests after each small edit, and commit comment-only fixes separately.

friction: The review finding about parameter coverage contradicted the worker's report, requiring manual verification of the tests.
The `file` mutant fails in setup rather than under its named case, so that parameter is covered less sharply than the others.
Doc comment over 120 columns required two edits plus a format pass to satisfy the lint gate.
Workers for #519 and #523 were still running, so the overall task was not finished.
open_items: Resolve the remaining review findings: stale TSRS_READS snapshot, missing nested validation for fileSystem/changes, createSnapshot row mismatch, and the Request trait simplification.
Decide whether to loosen or isolate the exact printed-type assertion that depends on tsrs defaults and printer.
Push the comment-fix commit and mark the finding resolved on the PR.
Wait for the #519 and #523 workers to finish and review their results.
The optional clone of root paths in open_in_memory could be removed if it matters on a hot path.
